Three more ways in.

The Walkathon is the big one, but it is not the only one. These three run all year, cost little or nothing, and every dollar lands in the same place.

Hugs from Henry Rent the Rock Spirit Nights

Grades K–5

Hugs from Henry Birthday Club.

Enroll your K–5th grader and we dedicate a classroom book in honor of your child, with a special “Hugs from Henry” bookplate on the inside front cover.

$25 per child

Pay by check or PayPal. Checks are payable to The Friends of Hendricks and can be turned in to your student's teacher, or mailed to 4446-1A Hendricks Avenue, Suite 357, Jacksonville, FL 32207.

Future safety restrictions could prohibit the cupcake party and the photo with Henry. If it is cancelled for weather or for safety, the party is rescheduled for the next month.

Give a Hug Email the birthday club

24 hours

Rent the HAE Spirit Rock.

The Friends of Hendricks manage the two School Spirit Rocks. Reserve one for 24 hours and paint it — congratulate a student, wish someone a happy birthday, cheer on a classmate, or thank a teacher who earned it.

  • $35one rock, front or back, 24 hours
  • $60both rocks, front and back, 24 hours

There are two: the front rock on the Hendricks Avenue side, and the back rock on the San Jose Boulevard side. Booking and payment both happen on SignUpGenius, where you pick your date and your rock and agree to the terms of use. Payment is due at the time of reservation.

Rent the Spirit Rock Ask a question

Email replies come within 48 business hours.

An easy way to support our school

Spirit Nights.

Turn family dinner into school support. Dine at a participating restaurant on the night, and a portion of total sales goes straight to Hendricks Avenue Elementary.

You get a break from cooking, the kids get to see their classmates outside school, and the school benefits with every bite. Tell them you are there for Hendricks Avenue Elementary.

Spirit Night dates 2026–2027

  • Fri 28 Aug3–7pm · Gators Ice Cream · 15% of sales
  • Mon 14 Sep5–7pm · Chick-Fil-A Lakewood · 10% of sales
  • Thu 8 Oct3–6pm · Cookie Fix · 10% of sales
  • Wed 18 Nov4–8pm · Chipotle Lakewood · 25% of sales · online/app code GBT9687
  • More to come!dates are added through the year

Dates and times are subject to change.

None of this needs a big check.

A book, a painted rock, a Tuesday dinner out. It adds up to the things the county budget will not cover.
